description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data sources in the combined training set. The chart is divided into 12 slices, each representing a different data source. The slices are labeled with their corresponding data source names and percentage values, and are colored differently, although the exact shades are not distinguishable. The largest slice, labeled "NQ" and colored blue, accounts for approximately 31.3% of the total, while the smallest slice, labeled "SCIFACT" and colored dark green, represents about 0.1%. The other slices, in descending order of size, are "FEVER" (16.1%, light blue), "SNLI" (15.4%, orange), "VITAMINC" (13.0%, teal), "MULTINLI" (11.3%, red), "ANLI" (4.6%, purple), "FACTCC" (2.6%, green), "ENTFA" (1.8%, light green), "XSUMHUL" (1.6%, light purple), "SCITAIL" (1.2%, brown), "PUBHEALTH" (0.5%, dark orange), and "MULTIFC" (0.5%, light brown). The percentage labels are placed outside the chart, connected to their corresponding slices by lines, and there is no legend or visual emphasis on any particular slice. The slices appear to be arranged in no particular order, with the largest slice, "NQ", positioned at the top.
